result.topic_en: Euler begins the numerical calculation of the number t by labelling the terms of the series with Roman numerals and tabulating recursive logarithmic formulas for series P and term ratios for series P'.
result.transcription:
) 184 (
Calculus
Pro inueſtigando valore numeri $t$.
§. 32. Quoniam hic quatuor ſeries euolui debent, deſignemus terminos cuiusque ſeriei ordine per cyphras romanas I, II, III, IV, etc. atque pro ſeriebus P et P', in ſubſidium vocentur ſequentes formulae:

Pro ſerie P | Pro ſerie P'
$l\,\mathrm{II} = l\,\mathrm{I} + l\,t - 1,3802112$ | $\mathrm{II}' = \frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{II}$
$l\,\mathrm{III} = l\,\mathrm{II} + l\,t - 1,7201593$ | $\mathrm{III}' = \frac{1}{8}\,\mathrm{III}$
$l\,\mathrm{IV} = l\,\mathrm{III} + l\,t - 2,0122340$ | $\mathrm{IV}' = \frac{1}{11}\,\mathrm{IV}$

$l\,\mathrm{XI} = l\,\mathrm{X} + l\,t - 2,9837228$ | $\mathrm{XI}' = \frac{1}{32}\,\mathrm{XI}$
$l\,\mathrm{XII} = l\,\mathrm{XI} + l\,t - 3,0637814$ | $\mathrm{XII}' = \frac{1}{35}\,\mathrm{XII}$

items.quote: Quoniam hic quatuor ſeries euolui debent, deſignemus terminos cuiusque ſeriei ordine per cyphras romanas I, II, III, IV, etc. atque pro ſeriebus P et P', in ſubſidium vocentur ſequentes formulae
items.english: Since four series must be expanded here, let us denote the terms of each series in order by the Roman numerals I, II, III, IV, etc., and for the series P and P' let the following formulas be called in as aids.
For investigating the value of the number t.
